$comment: Visual models only; gameplay never depends on meshes. Files are relative to publicassets/. Set an assignment to null (or remove it) to restore the built-in placeholder. rotationOffset = Euler XYZ degrees that turns the model to face +X with +Y up (glTF convention). Cars are auto-fitted to the hitbox length unless 'scale' is given.

models.$comment: Shop car body (src/game/cosmetics/cars.ts). Every car model is loaded at startup: cars wear the body in their loadout. No flame nodes: the boost comes out of the two round rear dots (Lamp discs, model space), with the standard flame.

stadium.$comment: Stadium pieces (kind 'prop', +X facing the field, +Y up). null = the built-in piece. Generators for the shipped ones: tools/blender/*.py.
